newsitem.title: CANADA: Starbucks to close distribution center.
newsitem.headline: Starbucks to close distribution center.

text.p: Starbucks Coffee Co said on Monday it would close a distribution center in July that supplied pastries to its outlets around Vancouver.
The Seattle-based company said the decision was driven by "business reasons." The operation was a pilot project that had been under review since 1994.
The distribution center was one of nine Starbucks locations in British Columbia recently unionized. The employees have threatened to strike over a contract dispute and the two sides are in mediation.

Starbucks said it informed the Canadian Auto Workers Union that it intended to close the distribution center. The company is reviewing options for the nine workers at the distribution center including reassigning them to other jobs in the company and severance packages.
